family_summary: Across the four site pairs, AI-built pages mostly use distinct, bold or themed palettes (navy/cyan, monochrome green, burnt orange on cream, red/blue/charcoal) with alternating full-width color bands, and use light or off-white backgrounds in about half of cases versus originals that are more often near-black, grey or white with a single accent; AI builds also showed one case of dark text on a dark ground and shifted accent roles and hues.

attributes.summary: AI-built pages most commonly use an off-white body background (2 of 4 sites, the others near-black and pale grey-blue), whereas originals lean darker or neutral (2 near-black, 1 pale grey, 1 white).

The one AI-built page observed uses mid grey for secondary text, with no recorded original value to compare.
Both AI-built sites with this observation alternate full-width background bands (dark or colored), while the originals are mostly white with few strips or have stacked grey footer bands.
AI-built pages split between dark text with green links and context-varied link styles, while originals use grey text with role-split links or orange links, with no single pattern dominant.
On the one site observed, the AI-built page shows dark text on a dark ground while the original text is readable.
